newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London steady, blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London steady, blue chips gain.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were steady to firmer on Thursday with bargain-hunting in high-tech blue chip stocks the feature of the day, dealers said.

Shares in Sony Corporation rose 60 yen to close at 9820 yen, lifted by a solid performance by high-tech stocks on NASDAQ on Wednesday and by investors taking advantage of recent falls among exporters. Sharp Corporation gained 12.5 yen 1522.5 yen.
Elsewhere, dealers said volumes were thin, with the recent narrow trading range of the Tokyo market failing to provide an incentive for investors to open new positions in London.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index in London nudged up 5.42 points to close at 1,597.3 after the Nikkei 225 rose 57.61 points to finish at 19,754.78.
